reviews.text: Yesterday I took my AIREDALE TERRIER to the groomer, this is the fantastic result thanks to Gabriella's hand, also highly recommended for Self washing.
Fantastic service! Special thanks to Nicole for her patience and kindness with my Golden Retriever. Her coat is perfect, soft, and well cared for. Impeccable grooming, we'll definitely be back!

Not good, be careful about safety.
After the grooming, my dog ​​slipped from her restraint and fell from the table from a height significant for her size. She's a 10-year-old dog with a gentle temperament.
Those who work in this profession are professionally responsible for the dog's safety throughout the entire service, from pick-up to return. In this case, this responsibility was not demonstrated. The staff only focused on defending themselves and blaming me for what happened.
Furthermore, they didn't care about the dog after the fall. They didn't even spend a minute checking on my dog.
I find it appalling that those who work in this profession show so little empathy and refuse to take responsibility for their actions. Highly not recommended.

Clean place and friendly staff. The center offers two types of services: in-house grooming (which I didn't have the opportunity to use) and self-washing. There are two separate stalls with everything you need for a wash. Very well laid out and organized, starting with the platforms for even large dogs to climb into the tubs. Shampoo and conditioner are available and seem to be of excellent quality. The drying area is made of micro-perforated steel so as not to cause damage to the dog's paws but at the same time allows moisture to escape. If you buy a card, you can access even when the shop is closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and evenings in general. The cost for three washes is €63. There is a time limit, but it's so long I don't even remember it (I think it was two and a half hours per wash). When you first come in, they explain how everything works, and if you have a problem outside of business hours, a representative's phone number is available and they can help (I personally had an emergency and was in the shop within 15 minutes).
My border collie, Charlie, was wonderful during and after Nicole's service. It took 1 hour and 15 minutes, including washing and brushing. I had a great experience and will be back. Price: €70.00.

Clean and professional grooming, excellent work, and thanks again.
See you soon!

I've been bringing Brando (my Lagotto) here for over a year for a bath and a haircut. I'm very happy with him, and we've become very fond of him! The girls take care of him with soooo much patience and professionalism, and he's always beautiful when he comes home, so we're very satisfied ☺️
Thank you very much Giuseppe for your excellent rating
Thanks Carlo for the excellent rating.

Spacious self-service grooming station.
Hot water (with or without soap), conditioner, and drying service. A pleasant experience for your dog.

We've already been back twice and will definitely be back again! Our dog is always greeted with kindness and professionalism. After every bath, his fur is incredibly soft, smells wonderful, and is cared for down to the smallest detail. Even his nail trimming, which we'd never had before, was done with care and kindness.

You can tell they put love and expertise into everything they do. Our puppy feels at ease, and that means a lot to us.
Impeccable service, highly recommended to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friend! 🐶💖

Thank you so much, see you soon!
Greetings from Rolly! 🐾 🩷
My dog's first bath and haircut: a truly positive experience. They treated her every step with care and sensitivity! Highly recommended.
Helpful and friendly!!! I highly recommend both the very clean self-service restaurant and the excellent staff!!!
Fast, courteous and my dog ​​smelled wonderful and was very soft.

I went to Wash Dog for a one-time do-it-yourself wash for my pointer (no membership required). The cost is €20 for half an hour, all-inclusive, which was plenty of time to wash and dry a large, short-haired dog. The staff were extremely kind and helpful, explaining the process thoroughly. The kennel was comfortable, clean, and well-equipped. It was fun and easy, I recommend it!
